experiment: Kev typed-choice option-order robustness; paired three-arm screening

design.batching: 18 block-isolated typed choice questions per case; one model forward per case
design.primary_endpoint: case-then-family weighted mean probability assigned to the prespecified expected action; PoL2 minus length-matched neutral
design.inference_unit: 8 prespecified task families; six option permutations are repeated measurements, not independent samples
design.calibration: checkpoint-fitted temperature applied, matching official Space calibrated mode; argmax is unchanged
design.randomization_test: two-sided exact sign-flip on the 8 family-level paired primary differences
design.paired_test: two-sided exact sign-flip test on the 8 family-level differences; inference assumes sign exchangeability under the null

model.source_protocol: Kev official Space code at pinned revision; checkpoint loader and typed choice API; fp32, SDPA
